summary: Diff adds phone-number-based unlocking logic for the Administrator role in ProfileSetupDialog, including auto-deselect when the phone stops matching and a guard to prevent admin allowlist backend calls unless the admin option remains unlocked. However, the diff excerpt is truncated and does not provide direct evidence of the Administrator option being conditionally rendered/hidden in the role list or that the phone input is positioned/available at role-selection time. Diff also updates project metadata/summaries not requested.

missing_requirements.requirement: Hide the "Administrator" role option by default and only reveal it when the phone number input normalizes (digits-only) to 91980115950; when not matched, the Administrator option is not rendered/visible in the role selection list.
missing_requirements.reason: The shown code implements an `isAdminOptionUnlocked` flag, but the truncated diff does not include the JSX where role options are rendered, so there is no direct evidence that the Administrator radio option is actually conditionally not rendered/hidden when locked.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure the phone number input is available to the user at the time they choose a role (so they can unlock Administrator).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff excerpt shows phone state and a change handler, but does not show the dialog layout/ordering; there is no direct evidence that the Phone Number input is presented before or alongside the role selection UI (i.e., available at the moment of role choice).
